// Fixed types for task (f). Do not edit; check.sh uses its own copy.
import type { ReadonlyStore } from "@get-modular/observation";

/** The panel's own slice of the settings. */
export type RegionSettings = { readonly region: string };
export type PanelDeps = { readonly settings: ReadonlyStore<RegionSettings> };

/** Synchronous: the display name of a region. */
export declare function regionLabel(region: string): string;
/** An existing adapter. Honors `signal`: rejects with an AbortError once it is aborted. */
export declare function fetchHolidays(region: string, options: { readonly signal: AbortSignal }): Promise<readonly string[]>;

export type Holidays =
  | { readonly status: "loading" }
  | { readonly status: "ready"; readonly region: string; readonly days: readonly string[] }
  | { readonly status: "failed"; readonly region: string; readonly cause: unknown };
export type PanelView = { readonly label: string; readonly holidays: Holidays };
export type PanelPort = { readonly view: () => PanelView };

export type PanelProduct = { readonly instance: undefined; readonly capabilities: { readonly "acme/region-panel": PanelPort } };
